title: radiation.skill_card/1 — Skill Catalog Spine
description: Typed record for skills present in-tree (agent skills under agents/**, procedure skills under scaffolding/core and subskills). P-17 G4: skills become typed, schema-checked records with eval pointer per skill. MEM-shrine-log is a deliberate outer-corpus pointer (docs/shrine/LOG.md — Commander heartbeat record); all other catalog paths MUST live under Brain/.

id.description: unique id SKILL-NNN, zero-padded 3 digits, sorted, unique

entry_path.description: existing skill entry path relative to repo root, must exist

kind.description: agent=provider or subskill agent, procedure=core proc or pipeline skill

eval_ref.description: path to test/eval proving skill, must resolve

status.description: active=has eval, declared=needs note, deprecated=needs superseded_by

activation_note.description: pinned if activation machine-pinned by check 28, else asserted

note.description: optional note, required if status declared

superseded_by.description: required if status deprecated, id of skill that supersedes this
